Meeting brief · One page, any width

The full page and the companion are the same page. Make the window narrow and it becomes the companion. Make it wide and it becomes the full brief. Drag the bottom right corner, or use the presets.
Width Meeting
Neuma · Neuma founders sync
One page, three widths
Above 980px it is the full page with the app sidebar. 600 to 980px drops the sidebar and stacks the side cards. Below 600px it is the companion.
Narrow changes the order, not the content
The header shrinks to the meeting strip. Sections become tabs. Why text clamps to one line with More. Items 4 and 5 hide behind Show 2 more.
Pop out is just a resize
Pop out opens this page in a narrow window that stays on top of the call. The expand icon in the companion widens it back. No second screen to build.
Before and Live
Before the meeting the header shows the countdown and Join. Once it starts, it shows Live and the timer. Hover a To discuss item to tick it off.

Same brief, any call
The same panel as Zoom in Screen 5.2. Tabs, ranking, Why, ticks and dismiss behave the same everywhere.
Matched from the calendar
Neuma matches the meeting to a Context. The switcher at the top of the panel fixes a wrong match and teaches the rule.
Host is the organiser
The calendar organiser gets the Host view. Attendees on your domain with Neuma see the Attendees view.
On top, out of the way
The window pins above the call. Widen it and the full brief appears in place. Nothing to jump to.
